subagent_reports.topic: Archive finalization reachability re-proof after change branch/worktree cleanup

sources.label: verifyChangeBranchReachable (branch-ref-dependent proof)
sources.summary: Reachability proof uses `git log ${defaultBranch}..change/${changeId}`. Returns reachable:false on any non-zero git exit. Requires the change/{id} branch ref to exist.

sources.label: resolveReleaseReachability no_remote route — NO structural fallback
sources.summary: no_remote branch calls ONLY verifyChangeBranchReachable; on failure returns proof local_unmerged. Unlike direct (2697-2712) and PR routes (2779-2793), there is NO detectSquashMergeByTree fallback. A cleaned-up branch ref cannot be re-proven shipped.

sources.label: resolveReleaseReachability direct route tree fallback (changeTipSha-gated)
sources.summary: Calls detectSquashMergeByTree with changeTipSha threaded. Survives branch deletion ONLY if input.changeTipSha is provided.

sources.label: detectSquashMergeByTree — content-addressed, 50-commit window
sources.summary: tipRef = deps.changeTipSha ?? change/{id} (line 1436). Scans last 50 trunk commits comparing tree SHAs. Squash-merge-safe. Bounded to 50 commits (line 1450) — deep history may miss.

sources.label: Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema declares changeTipSha, NOT mergeCommitSha
sources.summary: changeTipSha declared (line 1117) with SC1 comment 'captured at archive dispatch time... survive branch deletion'. mergeCommitSha is NOT in the schema. This is the intended branch-deletion-survival field.

sources.label: changeTipSha is NEVER WRITTEN by production code (ROOT CAUSE)
sources.summary: phase9Done is built via preservePhase9Evidence(latest.phase9_status, {...}) and sets status/startedAt/completedAt/route/prNumber/prUrl/mergeCommitSha/autoMergeArmed but OMITS changeTipSha. preservePhase9Evidence only carries changeTipSha FORWARD from a previous value that is always undefined. No capture site exists anywhere. Confirmed by exhaustive grep: all other refs are reads/threading/preservations or test fixtures.

sources.label: changeTipSha read/thread sites (consumers of the never-set value)
sources.summary: All consumers read phase9_status?.changeTipSha (always undefined) and thread it into resolveReleaseReachability/detectSquashMergeByTree. The tree fallbacks are dead in production.

sources.label: verifyReleaseEvidenceFromMain — existing-bundle re-proof entry point
sources.summary: Re-derives release proof from main checkout when worktree is gone. Calls resolveReleaseReachability with changeTipSha (always undefined). For a no_remote change with deleted branch → local_unmerged → blocked. The exact reported failure.

sources.label: finalizeRelease no_remote fast path returns shipped directly
sources.summary: Primary archive path returns shipped from in-band mergeCommitSha WITHOUT calling resolveReleaseReachability. So first-time no_remote archive works; only re-proof/retry/doctor fails.

sources.label: Archive retry + projection-proof re-derivation paths
sources.summary: When in-band finalization is unavailable, proofOutcome = verifyReleaseEvidenceFromMain(...). If status!==shipped || !releasedCommitSha → hard failure 'cannot prove accepted delta projection'. This is where the re-proof gap surfaces to users.

sources.label: deleteChangeBranch — the cleanup that removes the ref
sources.summary: git branch -d change/{id} + remote delete. After this, verifyChangeBranchReachable fails for all subsequent re-proof.

sources.label: rq-releaseFinalization01 (MUST) — origin/PR merge proof requirement
sources.summary: no_remote may complete local-only (Merged locally.); release recovery MUST revalidate the same origin/default or merged-PR proof before recording release. Manual merge/push recovery revalidates the same proof. The no_remote local proof after branch deletion is the gap relative to 'revalidate the same proof'.

sources.label: merge-base --is-ancestor pattern already in codebase
sources.summary: Exact ancestry proof via git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> <ref> is an established pattern. Viable simpler alternative for real-merge routes (no_remote/direct) but not for squash-merge (PR) routes.

sources.label: Existing tests: direct+deleted+changeTipSha, merge_queue+deleted+changeTipSha; NO no_remote+deleted+changeTipSha test
sources.summary: Coverage exists for direct (590) and merge_queue (1397) deleted-branch + changeTipSha tree recovery. no_remote has ONLY the unmerged failure case (1241-1269). The no_remote recovery case is untested and unimplemented.

sources.label: archived-branch-cleanup — local-branch enumeration, fail-closed
sources.summary: detectArchivedMergedBranches enumerates LOCAL change/* branches via git branch --list (git-finalize.ts:2285-2307). A deleted branch never appears, so cleanup/doctor cannot find or re-drive it. Cleanup is squash-merge-safe (detectSquashMergeByTree) and fail-closed.

subagent_reports.architecture_assessment: Reachability re-proof has a branch-name dependency throughout the no_remote route and a branch-name fallback in direct/PR routes that depends on a persisted changeTipSha value that is never captured. Concretely: (1) resolveReleaseReachability's no_remote branch (git-finalize.ts:2605-2629) calls only verifyChangeBranchReachable, which runs `git log ${defaultBranch}..change/${changeId}` — a branch-ref query that fails once deleteChangeBranch (git-finalize.ts:409-439) removes the ref, and there is no detectSquashMergeByTree fallback in this branch (unlike direct 2697-2712 and PR routes 2779-2793). (2) The tree fallbacks that DO exist are gated on input.changeTipSha, which is read from phase9_status.changeTipSha in 5 consumer sites — but that field is never written: change.ts:619-634 builds phase9Done without changeTipSha, and preservePhase9Evidence only carries it forward from a prior undefined value. So in production input.changeTipSha is always undefined and the direct/PR tree fallbacks never fire. Net effect: the primary first-time archive works (finalizeRelease returns shipped from the in-band merge outcome for no_remote at git-finalize.ts:3392-3404), but any subsequent re-proof (archive retry change.ts:4284/4628 via verifyReleaseEvidenceFromMain, adv_doctor, re-verification) cannot re-establish shipped proof once the change branch/worktree is cleaned up — surfacing as 'cannot prove accepted delta projection' for changes with accepted deltas. The declared design intent (Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema SC1 comment, types/changes.ts:1114-1117; rq-fixPhase9SquashMergeRedetect) is clearly changeTipSha capture + content-addressed tree detection; it is simply unimplemented at the write site and missing for the no_remote route.

validation.notes: No in-scope blocker prevents proceeding to design. The defect is real and bounded: primary ship path is unaffected; only post-cleanup re-proof breaks. Two safe, well-supported remediation strategies exist (see architecture_judgement.alternatives_considered). The caution (not pass) reflects: a declared field never written, two dead-code fallbacks, a missing no_remote fallback, and no test for the no_remote recovery case.

tradeoffs: changeTipSha tree-detection is squash-merge-safe but bounded to the last 50 trunk commits (git-finalize.ts:1450); a deeply-buried squash-merge could be missed — recommend increasing the window or making it configurable for recovery paths

Tree-SHA equivalence can produce a false positive if two unrelated commits share an identical tree (rare); the cherry/patch-equivalent secondary check (git-finalize.ts:2357-2377) mitigates but is only wired into detectArchivedMergedBranches, not resolveReleaseReachability

Activating changeTipSha capture must happen BEFORE branch deletion and must reflect the post-archive-commit tip (the change/{id} HEAD after commitArchiveArtifacts), not a stale pre-commit SHA — capture timing is correctness-critical

is-ancestor on a persisted mergeCommitSha is exact and cheaper for no_remote/direct real-merges but does not cover squash-merge (PR) routes where the original commit is dropped, so it cannot be the sole mechanism

phase9_status.mergeCommitSha is currently set at change.ts:630 but is NOT in Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema (types/changes.ts:1095-1118) — relying on it as proof source requires adding it to the schema rather than relying on strip/passthrough behavior

alternatives_considered.option: Strategy A — activate changeTipSha capture + add no_remote tree fallback (matches declared design intent)
alternatives_considered.rationale: Aligns with Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema SC1 comment (types/changes.ts:1114-1117) and rq-fixPhase9SquashMergeRedetect. Makes existing dead tree-fallbacks (direct 2697, PR 2779) live and adds parity for no_remote. Captured SHA is content-addressed and already consumed by historical-repair.ts:116-123. Requires: (a) capture git rev-parse change/{id} (post archive-artifact commit) into phase9_status.changeTipSha at change.ts:619-634; (b) add detectSquashMergeByTree(changeTipSha) fallback to the no_remote branch of resolveReleaseReachability (git-finalize.ts:2612-2628), using the local defaultBranch (no origin); (c) tests for no_remote+deleted+changeTipSha and capture-site persistence. Covers all routes uniformly.

alternatives_considered.option: Strategy B — is-ancestor proof on a schema-declared mergeCommitSha (simpler, no_remote/direct only)
alternatives_considered.rationale: git merge-base --is-ancestor <mergeCommitSha> <defaultBranch> is exact, already used in the codebase (archive.ts:541, worktree/index.ts:1877), and no_remote/direct routes produce real merge commits. BUT: requires adding mergeCommitSha to Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema; does NOT cover squash-merge PR routes (original commit dropped). Best used as a cheap, exact first check for no_remote/direct before falling back to tree-detection, not as a replacement for Strategy A.

alternatives_considered.option: Persisted-shipped short-circuit (trust prior releasedCommitSha/mergeCommitSha without re-querying git)
alternatives_considered.rationale: rq-releaseFinalization01 explicitly requires release recovery to REVALIDATE the same origin/default or merged-PR proof before recording release — a trust-the-prior-value shortcut would violate the revalidation requirement and weaken tamper-evidence. The proof must be re-derived from git/GitHub authority on retry.

alternatives_considered.option: Recreate the change branch to re-run verifyChangeBranchReachable
alternatives_considered.rationale: Branch recreation is a heavier mutation, reintroduces the ref ADV just cleaned up, and couples re-proof to worktree/branch existence — the opposite of the branch-deletion-survival goal. detectSquashMergeByTree's content-addressed tip already avoids this.

architecture_judgement.recommendation: Proceed to design with Strategy A as primary: (1) add changeTipSha capture at change.ts:619-634 (post archive-artifact commit, pre branch deletion) so the SC1 design field is actually populated; (2) add a detectSquashMergeByTree(changeTipSha) fallback to the no_remote route in resolveReleaseReachability (git-finalize.ts:2605-2629) using the local defaultBranch, mirroring direct/PR routes; (3) add the three missing tests (no_remote+deleted+changeTipSha tree recovery; no_remote+deleted+no changeTipSha stays local_unmerged; capture-site persists changeTipSha). Consider Strategy B (is-ancestor) as a cheap exact pre-check for no_remote/direct with schema-declared mergeCommitSha, but it cannot replace A for squash-merge routes. Verify capture SHA reflects post-commit-artifact tip, and consider raising the 50-commit tree-scan window (git-finalize.ts:1450) for recovery paths.

subagent_reports.recommendation: Implement Strategy A (activate changeTipSha capture + no_remote tree-detection fallback) as the primary fix; it matches the declared Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema design intent, unblocks existing dead fallbacks for all routes, and aligns with how historical-repair.ts already consumes changeTipSha. Acceptance criteria: (AC1) phase9_status.changeTipSha is persisted at archive completion (change.ts:619-634), reflecting the post-archive-commit change/{id} tip; (AC2) resolveReleaseReachability no_remote route re-proves shipped via detectSquashMergeByTree(changeTipSha) when the live branch ref is gone; (AC3) re-proof stays local_unmerged when changeTipSha is absent (no false shipped); (AC4) verifyReleaseEvidenceFromMain returns shipped for a no_remote change whose branch was cleaned up after a successful merge; (AC5) tests cover no_remote+deleted+changeTipSha recovery, no_remote+deleted+no-changeTipSha failure, and capture-site persistence; (AC6) rq-releaseFinalization01 revalidation semantics preserved (re-derives from git authority, does not trust prior value).
follow_ups: adv_change_show timed out (Temporal worker) during this research; ADV state (proposal/problem-statement/design) for fixArchivedBranchFinalization could not be read via tooling. Orchestrator should retry adv_change_show or adv_doctor to confirm the change's stated scope matches these code findings before planning.

Verify Phase9FinalizationStatusSchema interaction with the persisted phase9_status round-trip: mergeCommitSha is set at change.ts:630 but absent from the schema (types/changes.ts:1095-1118). If Strategy B is pursued, mergeCommitSha must be added to the schema; if only Strategy A, confirm changeTipSha round-trips correctly (it IS declared).

Consider raising the 50-commit trunk tree-scan window in detectSquashMergeByTree (git-finalize.ts:1450) for recovery paths, or adding a full-history fallback (git log --all / merge-base check) to avoid missing deeply-buried squash-merges.

Read the canonical requirement text via adv_spec show capability:advance-workflow for rq-releaseFinalization01 and rq-fixPhase9SquashMergeRedetect to lock acceptance criteria against the authoritative spec (semantic search surfaced rendered prose; spec read should go through the adv_spec tool).

documents.proposal:
# Fix archived branch finalization

## Why

A merged change can remain unable to finalize release when normal cleanup has removed its local `change/<id>` branch and worktree. This leaves an archived bundle with a pending release gate.

## What Changes

Make archive finalization validate reachability from a trusted persisted release/archive SHA when the named change branch is absent. Preserve the normal branch path and refuse fallback when no valid SHA evidence is available.

## User Outcomes

- A merged, cleaned-up change completes archive finalization after fresh Git proof.
- Archive release proof remains tied to an explicit validated commit.
- Cleanup does not require manual branch recreation.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Archive finalization reachability proof for cleaned-up change branches.
- Regression coverage for branch-missing, SHA-reachable finalization.
- Retry of the blocked `fixAcceptanceRecovery` archive after this repair merges.

### Out of Scope
- Recreating deleted branches or worktrees.
- Deriving fallback proof for legacy archives without a persisted SHA.
- Weakening reachability verification or broad changes to cleanup behavior.

## Constraints

- Only a schema-validated persisted SHA may be used as fallback proof.
- The fallback commit must be freshly revalidated against the resolved default remote branch.
- Existing branch-based release finalization behavior remains unchanged when the branch exists.

## Discovery Findings

### Discovery Checklist
| Step | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Skills considered | PASS | `adv-worktree` and `adv-agent-tool-contracts`: isolation and typed state contracts apply. |
| Prior research extension | PASS | Archive failure diagnosis plus researcher source audit. |
| Conflict scan | DEGRADED | Related active release/recovery changes exist; one terminal candidate unavailable. No direct task overlap found. |
| Edge cases | PASS | Missing branch with SHA; missing SHA; tree proof mismatch; branch still present. |
| Design question depth | PASS | Fresh-proof and legacy-boundary decisions resolved with user. |
| Draft spec deltas | PASS | Existing release-finalization law needs implementation conformance; no new product capability law required. |
| Related pattern scan | PASS | `direct`/PR tree fallback exists; `no_remote` route omits it. |
| LBP check | PASS | Internal reliability defect; no external alternative applies. |
| Completeness verification | PASS | Capture and re-proof paths both checked; no sole-entry claim left unverified. |

### Current State
- Branch-based checks in `git-finalize.ts` fail when cleanup deletes `change/<id>`.
- `changeTipSha` is declared as cleanup-surviving proof but is never persisted.
- `no_remote` re-proof has no tree-based fallback; direct/PR paths already have one.

### Edge Cases
- Branch absent + persisted SHA tree found on default branch: finalization may proceed after fresh proof.
- Branch absent + no persisted SHA: preserve `CHANGE_BRANCH_NOT_REACHABLE_FROM_ORIGIN` and release remains pending.
- Persisted SHA tree not found: refuse finalization.
- Branch present: retain current branch reachability behavior.

### Open Design Questions
- Resolved: proof is re-derived from Git at retry; prior success is not trusted.
- Resolved: legacy archives without `changeTipSha` stay safely blocked.

### Draft Spec Deltas
No spec delta required. `rq-releaseFinalization01` already requires current reachability proof; this fixes a missing durable proof source.

### Related Pattern Scan

# Problem Statement

Archive finalization rejects a merged change after its `change/<id>` ref and worktree are cleaned up. The finalizer checks the branch name before evaluating persisted release/archive SHA evidence, returning `CHANGE_BRANCH_NOT_REACHABLE_FROM_ORIGIN` even when the archived commit is already reachable from `origin/trunk`.

## Root Cause Analysis

- Reproduction: `adv_change_archive phase9:"run"` for `fixAcceptanceRecovery` failed because `change/fixAcceptanceRecovery` was absent.
- Git evidence: archived commit `1b8fe6ff5c056e3e8d6b9f44c726f06724631792` is an ancestor of `origin/trunk`; the branch and worktree had already been cleaned up.
- Infrastructure: `adv_doctor` reported healthy server, worker, queue, and search attributes.
- Root cause: archive reachability validation treats the transient local branch name as the sole proof source instead of using a validated persisted SHA when that ref is absent.
- Safety boundary: do not recreate deleted branches or worktrees as a workaround; require strict SHA validation before fallback reachability proof.

# Agreement: Fix archived branch finalization

## Objectives
1. Let a merged change complete archive finalization after normal branch/worktree cleanup.
2. Preserve fresh, content-addressed Git proof as the sole release authority.
3. Leave legacy archives without durable tip evidence safely blocked.
4. Finalize `fixAcceptanceRecovery` after this repair is merged and verified.

## Success Criteria
- **SC1:** A cleaned-up, merged change reaches `release: done` and archived terminal state after one signed retry with fresh Git proof.
- **SC2:** A legacy archive without a persisted tip SHA remains pending/blocked and never reports release success.
- **SC3:** `fixAcceptanceRecovery` finalizes successfully after this repair merges.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1:** Archive dispatch persists a schema-valid 40-hex `changeTipSha` before cleanup removes the branch.
- **AC2:** When `change/<id>` is absent, `no_remote` re-proves reachability via the persisted SHA’s tree on the current default branch.
- **AC3:** A missing SHA or unmatched tree returns the existing reachability block and does not complete release.
- **AC4:** Existing branch-present, direct, and PR paths retain their current outcomes.
- **AC5:** Regression tests cover SHA capture, cleaned-branch success, and missing-SHA failure.
- **AC6:** Retry re-derives proof from Git and does not trust prior phase-9 success.

## Constraints
- The fallback accepts only the persisted, schema-validated SHA.
- Re-proof must use the resolved current default remote branch.
- Existing branch-present finalization behavior stays unchanged.

## Avoidances
- Do not recreate deleted branches or worktrees.
- Do not infer proof from untyped historical data.
- Do not extend fallback proof to legacy archives without `changeTipSha`.

## Scope
- Current repository only; no visual surface, preview, migration, environment, or external-service impact.
- `visual_surface: false`; preview expectation: `not_applicable`.

## Decisions
- A successful fresh retry completes automatically after user archive sign-off.
- Legacy missing-SHA bundles stay blocked.

# Design

## Architecture Overview

Archive finalization retains branch reachability as the primary proof. At dispatch, it additionally stores the change branch tip SHA in `phase9_status`. During a later `no_remote` re-proof, only an absent branch ref may trigger existing bounded tree matching against the current local default branch.

## Key Decisions

1. **Persist the change tip, not merge commit SHA.** `detectSquashMergeByTree` compares the change-tip tree; the default branch merge SHA is not equivalent.
2. **Reuse tree detection.** `direct` and PR routes already use `detectSquashMergeByTree`; extending its guarded use to `no_remote` avoids a new proof primitive.
3. **Fail closed.** Missing, malformed, or unmatched tip evidence keeps `local_unmerged` / reachability block; no historical phase-9 result is trusted.
4. **Keep the fallback narrow.** It is limited to absent branch refs in `no_remote`; branch-present, direct, PR, and redrive routes stay unchanged.

## Lever Citations

- Dispatch/phase-9 persistence takes effect through `plugin/src/tools/change.ts` phase-9 status write before cleanup.
- Re-proof takes effect at `plugin/src/tools/archive-helpers/git-finalize.ts` `resolveReleaseReachability` no-remote branch.
- Existing reusable proof primitive: `detectSquashMergeByTree` in `git-finalize.ts`.
- Outcome threading is consumed by `plugin/src/tools/change/archive-gate.ts` phase-9 evidence preservation and re-proof input.

## Implementation Strategy

1. Add `changeTipSha` to the finalization outcome and capture `rev-parse change/<id>` before the no-remote shipped outcome returns.
2. Persist that validated SHA into `phase9_status.changeTipSha` at the existing phase-9 status write.
3. When no-remote branch proof fails because the ref is absent, and only when `changeTipSha` exists, use bounded tree detection against the current default branch.
4. Add focused regression tests for capture, cleaned-ref success, absent/mismatched-tip failure, and unchanged branch-present behavior.
5. After merge, retry signed archive finalization for `fixAcceptanceRecovery`.

## LBP Analysis

This activates the schema-declared cleanup-surviving proof already used by other routes. It keeps Git as the live authority and avoids unsafe branch recreation.

## Affected Components

- `git-finalize.ts`: outcome, tip capture, no-remote fallback.
- `change.ts`: phase-9 outcome persistence.
- `archive-gate.ts`: existing preservation/threading verification.
- Focused finalization and phase-9 tests.

## Design-Derived Criteria

- Fallback is evaluated only after branch-ref proof is unavailable and only with a validated persisted SHA.
- Tree scan remains bounded to the existing 50 default-branch commits.
- Any Git command failure or mismatch returns non-reachable proof.

## Risks / Mitigations

- A bounded tree window can produce a false negative after many commits; it fails closed.
- `git branch -d` normally preserves unmerged branches, so absent no-remote refs may be uncommon; regression still covers recovery/cleanup states.
- Stale test comment near existing tree-proof coverage will be updated in touched scope.

## Validator Result

PASS — independent source validation found no contract conflict. It confirmed existing schema/threading and the reusable proof primitive; no user-value tradeoff or contract compromise exists.
